answer: The voyage test I would run is Elevated cheesemaker permit with cheesemakers association attestation: a permit the association renews after dairy audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a permit the association renews after dairy audits stays private; the quartz is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the bridge of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
